headline: RR Kabel to host analyst meets on Sep 28-29
summary: RR Kabel Limited has scheduled physical meetings with analysts and investors in Mumbai on September 28 and 29, 2026. The company confirmed no unpublished price-sensitive information will be shared.

headline: Shriram Finance to host select investors on Sep 24
summary: Shriram Finance Limited will hold a group meeting with select investors on September 24, 2026, in Mumbai. Senior management will discuss the investor presentation and public domain disclosures during the event.

headline: Mahanagar Gas to host analysts at BofA conference
summary: Mahanagar Gas Limited will participate in the BofA 2026 Asia Pacific Conference on September 21, 2026. The in-person group meetings aim to engage with investors under SEBI Regulation 30.

headline: Ambuja Cements to host investor meet on Sep 21
summary: Ambuja Cements Limited will interact with investors and analysts in Mumbai on September 21 and 22, 2026. The sessions, part of the JP Morgan and Anand Rathi conferences, will cover publicly available information only.

headline: Prime Industries to raise funds via preferential issue
summary: Prime Industries Ltd schedules board meeting on September 20, 2026, to consider a preferential issue and increase authorized share capital from ₹35 crore to ₹40 crore.

headline: Vaishno Cement AGM voting results and resolutions
summary: Vaishno Cement Co Ltd passed all six resolutions at its AGM held on September 15, 2026. Shareholders approved the adoption of FY26 financials and the reappointment of directors, with 90.67% of polled votes in favor.

headline: Amber Enterprises AGM: FY26 revenue hits ₹12,186 crore
summary: Amber Enterprises India Ltd held its 36th AGM on September 16, 2026. Consolidated revenue grew 22% YoY to ₹12,186 crore, driven by strong performance in electronics and consumer durables divisions.

headline: Kalpataru Projects gets IPO prospectus nod for Nasdaq Stockholm
summary: Kalpataru Projects International has received approval for its IPO prospectus to list on Nasdaq Stockholm, marking a significant cross-border capital market development.

headline: Sizemasters Technology holds 33rd AGM, approves RPTs
summary: Sizemasters Technology Limited concluded its 33rd AGM on September 16, 2026. Shareholders approved related-party transactions and reappointed a director via e-voting.

headline: Tech Mahindra to host investor meets on Sep 21-22
summary: Tech Mahindra Limited has scheduled physical investor interactions at the Anand Rathi and J.P. Morgan conferences in Mumbai on September 21 and 22, 2026.

headline: CMPDI schedules investor meets on Sept 21, 23
summary: Central Mine Planning & Design Institute Ltd has scheduled one-to-one analyst and investor meetings on September 21 and 23, 2026. The sessions will be conducted via video conferencing with InCred AMC and Motilal Oswal MF.

headline: Jaihind Industries schedules 39th AGM for October 11
summary: Jaihind Industries Limited has scheduled its 39th Annual General Meeting for October 11, 2026, at its registered office in Mumbai. The meeting will address business items for FY26.

headline: Allcargo Logistics to host investor meet on Sep 21
summary: Allcargo Logistics Ltd will host a virtual group meeting for analysts and institutional investors on September 21, 2026, from 4 pm to 5 pm. The session will cover Q1FY27 results using the public presentation.

headline: Sarvamangal Mercantile AGM: Resolutions Pass Unanimously
summary: Sarvamangal Mercantile Co. Ltd held its 43rd AGM on September 16, 2026. Members unanimously approved the adoption of audited financial statements for the year ended March 31, 2026, and re-appointed Director Vandana Somani.

headline: TGB Banquets AGM voting results declared
summary: TGB Banquets & Hotels shareholders approved FY26 financials and board appointments at the 27th AGM. Promoters voted 100% in favor of all resolutions.

headline: Diamines & Chemicals AGM: All 8 resolutions pass
summary: Diamines & Chemicals shareholders approved all eight resolutions at its 50th AGM on September 16, 2026. The vote covered financial statements, director appointments, and remuneration.

headline: Share India Securities reschedules board meeting to Sep 21
summary: Share India Securities Limited has moved its board meeting from September 18, 2026, to September 21, 2026. The company notified exchanges on September 16, 2026.

headline: Neptune Logitek acquires Neptune Cargo Services
summary: Neptune Logitek Ltd acquires 100% stake in newly incorporated Neptune Cargo Services Private Limited for logistics expansion. The wholly owned subsidiary will offer freight forwarding via sea, rail, and road.

headline: Sanghvi Movers promoter gift share transfer
summary: Maithili Rishi Sanghvi acquires 12.19% stake in Sanghvi Movers via gift from spouse Rishi Sanghvi. The off-market transaction involves 1.05 crore shares under SEBI SAST regulations.

headline: Surya Roshni AGM: Dividend, Director Reappointments Passed
summary: Surya Roshni shareholders approved a ₹2.50 dividend and reappointed key directors at the 53rd AGM. All eight resolutions passed with strong support.
